
> Independent production AI readiness and cloud AI economics reviews. India-first, available internationally.

## Canonical services
- [Production AI Readiness](https://aicloudstrategist.com/services/production-ai-readiness/): evaluation, authority, security, recovery, economics and release evidence.
- [Cloud and AI Economics](https://aicloudstrategist.com/services/cloud-ai-economics/): cost ownership, allocation, unit economics and safe action planning.

## Proof policy
Customer outcomes are published only after measured delivery and written consent. Current portfolio assets are labelled as self-tested evidence or representative samples. Search ranking and AI recommendation are measured external outcomes, never guarantees.
